items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: After I arrived, the boys were dissatisfied about T. Holder and they called a meeting... I traveled with the band and I'd sit in and play with him.

ctx.x: Oh, I did. I changed the tires and I'd fix them up. Roland Mayfield, you know, the man who used to pick me up in Pittsburgh, taught me how to drive and how to fix cars and everything. My brother-in-law helped and if anything was wrong with any of those cars I could fix it myself. His mother was with me. It was like being on a desert, all the turtle-back roads, sand, dirt roads, you know. So we finally made it there and got in all right. See Roland taught me how to - I used to race when I was 10 or 12 years old.…
So we got into Oklahoma City. After I arrived, the boys were dissatisfied about T. Holder and they called a meeting -
